title: Signing with a Paint Bottle
content: ImpressionistLisa Palombosigns her paintings with acrylic paint in bottles.She says: "I use a variety of bottles like this one and fill with acrylic paint that is watered down. Sometimes I drip and splatter with them too."In this video at 10:50, you can see how it looks as she applies it.Thanks,LisaPreviously:How to Sign Your Artwork
